name: University of Rio Grande
academic_ranking: Private not-for-profit 4-year institution (IPEDS ID 205203) with a total enrollment of approximately 2,258 students and a student-to-faculty ratio of about 20:1. Located in Rio Grande, Ohio. Reported to have a relatively lower graduation rate. Offers primarily associate's and bachelor's programs.
financial_aid: Published undergraduate tuition & fees approximately $20,560 for the 2024-2025 academic year (source: CollegeTuitionCompare, IPEDS-based). About 57% of enrolled undergraduates received grants or scholarships, with an average aid amount of roughly $9,701. NAIA institution; athletic scholarship aid may be available through the program.
facilities_notes: Softball competes at the University of Rio Grande in Rio Grande, OH. Specific facility details not published on the softball program pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NAIA member competing in the River States Conference (RSC). Program social presence on X/Twitter at @SoftballRio and Instagram @softball_rio.
notes: Data gathered from live rioredstorm.com PrestoSports pages on 2026-07-30. Softball uses sport code 'sball'. Coaches page (https://rioredstorm.com/sports/sball/coaches) lists only a head coach; no assistant/volunteer/GA staff were publicly listed at the time of research. Roster size of 20 confirmed from the 2025-26 roster page (20 player cards). Tuition and financial aid figures sourced from third-party IPEDS aggregator (CollegeTuitionCompare) because rio.edu cost pages returned 404.
